# mop-plugins (MiOpIIk)
Three small, **native-first** extensions for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Targets DSH **0.2.1-rc.5**. DSH
owns Agent Teams, subagents, search, skills, approvals, Worktrees, Ralph, and orchestration; this r
epository does not reimplement them.
## Packages
| Package                                                       | Version | Model-facing tools
| Why it exists
| `dsh-agent-rewind`     | 0.5.3   | `agent_checkpoint`, `agent_rewind`, `agent_checkpoint_list` | N
amed, Agent-readable checkpoint ledger and Session fork at a recorded boundary; distinct from DSH cr

ash recovery.               |
| `dsh-session-policy` | 0.5.3   | `session_rule`, `session_doctor`
| Reversible rules for the calling Session, plus runtime capability and tok

en projection diagnostics. Installs `dsh-agent-rewind`. |
| `mop-probe`                   | 0.1.2
| `mop_probe_env`                                             | Optional read-only audit of the mode
l-visible JSON Schema surface, including invalid object roots.                               |
The **six tools** are optional; no custom executor, model router, Agent Teams implementation, memory
engine, or replacement of DSH built-ins is shipped. `mop-probe` is deliberately separate, so ordina
ry Sessions do not need diagnostic tools.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
After changing a running profile, restart the DSH process that owns it (for example, `systemctl --us
er restart dsh-web.service` if installed as a user service).
Both policy and rewind can also be installed independently. Their `dsh.bundle.patch` entries contrib
ute only the two required host plugins; they do not modify DSH presets or permissions. `mop-probe` c
quired host plugins; they do not modify DSH presets or permissions. `mop-probe` contributes one row.
## Scope and guarantees
- **Named rewind** uses DSH's Session Fork primitives; fork creates a **new Session**, and it does n
ot restore working-tree files. Auto-checkpointing writes concise turn/error records to `.dsh/memory/

checkpoints.md`, with bounded pruning.
- **Session rules** are scoped to the calling Session and can
be injected, viewed or cleared through `session_rule`. They are not a substitute for DSH host permi

ssions.
- **Diagnostics** use DSH Services and token usage projections; a missing token projection i

s an unknown result, not zero consumption.
- **Tool audit** examines the exposed JSON Schema and rep
orts violations without blocking the agent. It is not a guarantee that arbitrary tools are safe to e
olations without blocking the agent. It is not a guarantee that arbitrary tools are safe to execute.
If upstream exposes an equivalent model-facing function, retire ours rather than add another compati
xposes an equivalent model-facing function, retire ours rather than add another compatibility layer.
## Test
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Composition tests use the **real** Cordis Loader from an installed DSH distribution or a built DSH c
heckout; see `test/composition/README.md`. Publishing guidance is in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
## History and maintenance
MiOpIIk originally experimented with a multi-layer Agent architecture, but DSH 0.2.x absorbed almost
all of it. This repository is now in **maintenance mode**: bug fixes and compatibility checks only.
Older design trees, experiment plans, and superseded compatibility notes were removed from the curr
ent checkout to avoid being mistaken for runtime documentation; they remain available in Git history
(see commit history through 2026-10-13). The local `.local/miopiik-archive/` is intentionally ignor
ed and was not touched by this cleanup.
